def count_components(n, edges):
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for u, v in edges:
        adj[u].append(v)
        adj[v].append(u)
    visited = []
    count = 0
    for start in range(n):
        if start in visited:
            continue
        count += 1
        stack = [start]
        visited.append(start)
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            for neighbour in adj[node]:
                if neighbour not in visited:
                    visited.append(neighbour)
                    stack.append(neighbour)
    return count
